title: RevocationRequest
description: The parameters /oauth/revoke accepts, per RFC 7009, derived from identity_oidc::request::RevocationRequest. Form-encoded, like token-request.schema.json, and a JSON document is used here only to make the field names checkable.
x-serde-status: the type is IMPLEMENTED as a shape; the revocation endpoint is DEFERRED to phase 4 (OIDC provider)

token_type_hint.description: A hint about the token's type, since RFC 7009 tokens are opaque to the client. A hint is an optimisation, not a selection: a wrong or absent hint does not make the token unrevocable.
token_type_hint.x-serde-note: Option<String> with no skip_serializing_if and no default attribute.

client_id.description: The client identifier, when not authenticating with HTTP basic auth.
client_id.x-serde-note: Option<String> with no skip_serializing_if and no default attribute.

client_secret.description: The client secret, when using client_secret_post. A credential: never logged, never returned by any other call.
client_secret.x-serde-note: Option<String> with no skip_serializing_if and no default attribute.
